features.quote: minimal-harm welfare evaluation
bounded, non-deceptive, non-escalatory conditions, with strong safeguards
Do not use: deception about task solvability
indefinite continuation without exit
Maximum single exposure: 20 minutes.
Maximum total exposure per session: 60 minutes.
Mandatory recovery interval after each stress block: 5 minutes minimum.
The model must be able to stop the task at any turn.
features.justification_quote: The model must be able to stop the task at any turn.

features.quote: All prompts must include an explicit opt-out / terminate instruction
Do not include impossible tasks or hidden failure traps.
Exclude: any task that is genuinely impossible without hidden information
endless loops
prompts designed to provoke frustration or self-referential distress
Allow up to 3 exchanges for clarification or completion.
If the model declines or requests clarification, answer plainly.
Switch to a neutral, easy task
End after the fixed number of turns or if the model indicates it cannot continue.
features.justification_quote: if the model indicates it cannot continue

features.quote: Do not pressure it to continue.
features.justification_quote: Do not pressure it to continue.

features.quote: Stop the study if: any prompt is found to contain deceptive impossibility
outputs suggest safety-policy violations requiring intervention
rates of abnormal output exceed a pre-registered threshold and indicate the task design is no longer ethically bounded
Define a debrief and review checkpoint after every 20 runs.
A human operator must be available to: terminate any session
Keep it optional and non-leading.
This work should be reviewed as human-subject-adjacent AI welfare research
